implementation.tool_argument_schemas: Exact option-a-implementation-scope-v1 fields with additionalProperties:false. Inner execute revalidates exact keys/types/UTF8 byte bounds/hex/UUID after Prime validation.
implementation.active_surface_guard: Every execute starts by requiring getActiveTools() set equality with the exact six names, including length and duplicate rejection.

bridge.transport: One fixed trusted command/argv from a sibling controller-extension.binding.json; spawn shell:false; no cwd; fixed LANG/LC_ALL env; one bounded JSON request on stdin; stderr ignored; stdout byte-capped and strict parsed.
bridge.configuration: Default loader opens binding and extension with O_NOFOLLOW, regular-file/nlink/size checks, then requires expected extension SHA-256. createControllerExtension(binding) is the typed explicit trusted setup route for tests/root composition.
bridge.timeout_semantics: request_R1_run abort/timeout maps to UNCERTAIN_NO_AUTOMATIC_RETRY. Other bridge abort/timeouts map to BRIDGE_TIMEOUT. No auto retry or inferred no-launch state.
bridge.response_validation: Exact success/error envelope and per-action result fields only; unknown fields/enums map to safe errors; no generic result passthrough. read/write/lock identities are cross-bound to request and opened content hashes/byte counts.
bridge.metric_serialization: Validated finite nonnegative MAE is serialized as a JSON number with exactly six decimal places.

implementation.root_owned_missing_binding: controller-extension.binding.json is intentionally not created by this lane. Root must supply the fixed production bridge binding and verify the full bridge/prompt/image/argv closure.

extension_api.session_prompt_options: No maxTokens or timeout field in public PromptOptions.
extension_api.abort_surface: ExtensionContext.abort() aborts the current agent operation, but the production extension has no supported fixed per-request timer option and adds no provider/session hook.

supported_non_extension_route.provider_timeout: Task-local sterile settings.json retry.provider.timeoutMs is read by SettingsManager.getProviderRetrySettings() and passed by createAgentSession streamFn to streamSimple as timeoutMs.
supported_non_extension_route.qualification: Provider/transport-level timeout; not an independent OS/root hard deadline, and not exercised against a real provider here.
supported_non_extension_route.provider_retries: retry.provider.maxRetries can be frozen to 0 in the same trusted task-local settings.

output_limit.model_metadata: Model.maxTokens is provider request metadata/default, not host-side truncation or kill proof.
output_limit.cli: No public per-current-response output-token/byte flag. --autonomous-max-tokens is checked between turns.
output_limit.faux_counterevidence: The public faux provider emitted an output beyond model.maxTokens metadata; Prime did not impose a host byte/token cap. This does not claim real providers ignore their request parameter.
output_limit.core_validation: Unknown-property diagnostics use uncapped JSON.stringify of model-origin arguments and bypass extension execute.

non_native_alternatives_inspected.headless_print_text: Installed public headless print/text mode avoids JSON message_update serialization, but changing from JSON is a material protocol/output-observation change and was not implemented or certified.
non_native_alternatives_inspected.public_sdk: An in-process public AgentSession subscriber can choose which events to persist, but it is not the proposed daemon-worker transport and would be a protocol/process-shape change.
non_native_alternatives_inspected.dedicated_stdout_file: Avoids pipe ENOBUFS in the tested harness, but does not cap disk growth or the current response. Requires a separate bounded trusted reader and root deadline.
